name: mcp-local-dev-bridge
description: Private bridge from an Agent Plugins host to a user-configured local MCP server for code development and PowerShell workflows.

interface.longDescription: Connects the host to a local MCP server through stdio. Designed for code inspection, debugging, testing, file edits, development commands, and PowerShell/PowerShell Remoting. Use npx to launch the Node MCP server from the user machine.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use my local MCP bridge to inspect, debug, test, and help modify my code. Use read-only tools freely when appropriate. Before file writes, development commands, or PowerShell actions with side effects, show what will happen and require user approval.
